notes.title: Game Changing BEEEG Update~!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aK1yPNe.gif[/img]

Hi everyone, good to see you guys again!

I brought some huge contents update for my game so let's check it out!

[h3]New Feature :[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added HP system.
[*] Added Items.
[*] Added Quest System.
[/list]

[h3]Fix :[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Angler fish event is not finishing.
[*] Fixed an memory leak issue when damage number object got created.
[/list]

[h3]Change :[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fluffy kitty got replaced with "Lucky Cat".
[/list]



[img]https://i.imgur.com/fe2YziF.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New Items are added In pond now~!
[*] let's check out what they can do it.
[/list]

[h2]Items[/h2]

[h3]H-Can:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gives you +1HP points.
[/list]

[h3]Zapper:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increase your reeling power with Zapping.
[/list]

[h3]Lightning Rod :[/h3]
[list]
[*] Upgrade your Zapper power, Increase your reeling power and sometime summons Thunder Strike!!
[/list]

[h3]Lucky Cat :[/h3]
[list]
[*]Gives you +9 Luck, Luck gives you more chance to get rare things and everytime when you get one, it uses your Luck.
[*]Stay with you untill the Luck points are ran out.
[/list]

[h3]HP slot :[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increase your Max HP +2:
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/e1x9q0p.png[/img]
[h2]Quest[/h2]
Ninja :
Do no admit you're a Ninja or Attack Ninja(-10), Catch a Salmon and surve a Sushi to Ninja.(+30)

Angler Fish :
Keep Catching Fishs untill Angler fish leaves.(+20)

Fren :
Catch a Single Boot and let fren have it.(+10)

That's all for now.
If there's anything bothers you or causing the troubles then let me know.

I'm thinking about to add some proper goal for this game untill the next month. wish me luck to make a good update for a game.

Ight hope you guys enjoys the New Feature and have a Spooky Halloween~!

notes.title: Little Hooky has been Launched today~!!
notes.notes:
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3217070/extras/LittleHookyGIF1.gif?t=1728983477[/img]

You could be a Hero, You Could be a Champion or Could be a Secret Ace of your team that no one understands your hard work today. you deserve something for a tiny moment. Look around first, if there's nothing that can stop you now then, Why don't we play a Little Hooky from what you are doing.

[h3]This game is Recommended for : [/h3]
[list]
[*] A person who's been waiting their matching queue for 5 minute.
[*] A person who's waiting their pizza delivery but can't play decent game for now.
[*] A person who's listening to the conversations between their friends but can't follow it.
[*] A person who's been looking at a clock for 10 minute to something to happen.
[*] A person who has over 200 games in their library but quite not sure what to play.
[/list]

[h3]Features : [/h3]
[list]
[*] Throw a Lure and hook up some fishes.
[*] Catch many fishes and get a high score.
[*] +9 colorful fishes and more funs.
[*] Tiny little events with special fishes.
[*] Try not to get murdered by The Ninja.
[*] Playing this game at your workplace could give you the pleasure and Thrill that
     cannot be held responsible.
[/list]

[h3]How to : [/h3]
[list]
[*] A and D key for Move Left and Right.
[*] Space or S key to Reel in.
[*] ESC key for Option and close game.
[/list]
